## Fixes

- Fixes the PowerShell command generated for Claude Code on systems running Windows PowerShell Constrained Language Mode.
- Adds a startup prompt to the generated Claude and Codex commands so the agent first calls `perfetto-get-trace-info` and analyzes the currently loaded Perfetto Desktop trace.

The command now creates the temporary MCP config file with `New-TemporaryFile` and writes it with `Set-Content`, avoiding the blocked `[IO.Path]::GetTempFileName()` .NET method call.

## Verification

- Added a regression test that prevents the generated PowerShell Claude command from using `[IO.Path]::GetTempFileName()`.
- Added a regression test that all generated CLI commands carry the loaded-trace startup prompt.
- Verified the replacement temp-file command shape in the local constrained PowerShell environment.
